1271

January 7, 1942.

Anti-Japanese and Pro-Comintern publication
to be submitted to Japanese Special Naval
Landing Party Settlement Headquarters.

On January 5, 1942, a sergeant of the Japanese
Special Naval Landing Party Settlement Headquarters,
No. 209 Foochow Road, accompanied by a Chinese
interpreter, called at various book-stores located
in Central and Louza Districts and instructed their
respective managements to submit all anti-Japanese
and pro-Comintern books and publications on hand to
their Headquarters within 6 days (before January 10)
for sealing. A notification, a translation of which
is as follows, was issued to every shop visited.

"It is known that anti-Japanese and pro-
Comintern books have for a long period been
published and sold in the International Settlement.
In order to maintain peace and good order in the
Settlement, the sale of this kind of book is
strictly prohibited. Those shops who have stock
of such literature must submit same to this
Headquarters for sealing within 6 days (before
January 10). As regards those publications
which are not definitely known to be anti-Japanese
or communistic in nature, one copy of each must
be submitted for censorship. Those ignoring this
order will be punished in accordance with Military
Law."

Japanese Special Naval Landing
Party Settlement Headquarters,
No. 209 Foochow Road.

(Chopped) Commander of the Settlement
Defence Corps.

(Date) January 5th, "17th year of Chao Wu"

共产国际
1271
9 / 42

1942年1月7日。

反日及亲共产国际出版物须提交至日本海军特别陆战队租界总部。

1942年1月5日，日本海军特别陆战队租界总部（福州路209号）的一名军曹，在中方翻译的陪同下，走访了位于中央区和老闸区的各家书店，并指示各店管理层在6天内（1月10日前）将所有库存的反日及亲共产国际书籍和出版物提交至其总部进行封存。向每家受访店铺发出了一份通知，译文如下：

“据悉，反日及亲共产国际书籍长期以来一直在公共租界出版和销售。为维护租界内的和平与良好秩序，严禁销售此类书籍。凡存有此类文献的店铺，必须在6天内（1月10日前）将其提交至本总部进行封存。至于性质是否确属反日或共产主义尚不明确的出版物，须每种提交一册以供审查。无视此命令者，将依军法惩处。”

日本海军特别陆战队
租界总部，
福州路209号。

（盖章） 租界防卫队司令。

（日期） “昭和”十七年一月五日

（印：归档 C. I. H₂）
